title: Theme
description: Light / dark / system: ThemeScript applies the stored theme before paint, ThemeProvider keeps it, ThemeSwitcher (three-way: segmented, or variant="menu" as one icon button) and ThemeToggle switch it, useThemeUtility() puts the three in AppShell's utilities. data-theme on any element re-scopes every token inside it.
when: Once in every app's root layout; the segmented switcher in settings, variant="menu" in a header or toolbar, useThemeUtility() in AppShell's utilities (and its rail).
a11y: ThemeSwitcher is a radio group; nothing is marked selected until the stored theme is known (no flash).

variant="menu" is an icon button named after the theme (aria-haspopup="menu"); its Menu lists the three choices with the current one checked: ↑/↓ move, Enter / Space pick, Escape closes and returns focus.

examples.title: Scoped theme
examples.description: data-theme on a wrapper fixes the theme of everything inside it.
